ratings_why.fun: Every turn is a real placement puzzle (where news starts, what touches the Mill-Chimney, who Wendelin sits by), but the reading load is heavy and We, the Rattenkönig flattens position right at the top.
ratings_why.distinct: 8 over 7: ties make every card's "touching" a graph you wire yourself, so Rats rewire Hedgerow runs, Chimney doubling and Wendelin's feed across tribes; no tribe today or generic auto-battler tribe plays like that.

verdict_why: Two Thirty-Two of Altenburg can feed each other's Start of Turn news forever, doubling each turn with a Mill-Chimney; that one loop needs closing.

points.text: Two Thirty-Two of Altenburg ping-pong: A's Start of Turn Gossip is heard by B at full, B re-broadcasts it next turn, A hears it back, forever; touching a Mill-Chimney doubles it every turn. Say a Thirty-Two doesn't hear another Thirty-Two's re-broadcast.
We, the Rattenkönig removes the halving that makes the tribe a puzzle. A version that halves once in total, not per step, keeps distance mattering at the top.
Wheel of Heads makes the Knot a ring for every card, so Hedgerow touching runs could loop; a line on where a looped run starts would let that combo be planned rather than argued.
Ratskeller Landlady triggers almost every turn with no choice. Tying the gold to something positional, such as hearing news from two different units, would give the thin economy a decision.

standouts.why: One tie rewires Chimney doubling, Wendelin's feed, the Alderman's tribe count, Supper Committee sales and other tribes' touching runs.
Turns an Ooze's Eat, a Pass or a shop spell into news; the best cross-tribe hook in the set.
Splitting hits into shares multiplies Bristle and Damage Reduction from other tribes, a combo the designer only half listed.

weakest.why: One obvious job that fires on its own.
A plain on-death trigger; the dead-slot rule does more than this card.
Vanilla Gossip; fine as a teacher but no overlap with anything.

flags.note: Two copies plus a Mill-Chimney: the same news doubles each turn with no new input.
Speaker + Chimney + Rattenkönig with a 40/40 gives every unit +40/+40 in a fight; fight-only, but huge.
An Ooze eating a big unit next to Wendelin, repeated by Ilse and re-broadcast by the Thirty-Two, lands three times.
How a ring Knot reads for other tribes' touching runs isn't stated.
